summary: Frontend-only test of Dashboard CollapsibleSection feature. Logged in as admin, navigated to /dashboard. Verified all 3 collapsible sections (coach/daily/stats) initially closed, hints visible in headers, WeekSchedule + Training Plan always visible, expand/collapse cycle works with correct aria-expanded toggling and 4 StatCards render inside stats body. 0 console errors during full cycle.
critical_code_review_comments: CollapsibleSection is clean and reusable; conditional child rendering keeps DOM light and matches test contract.
aria-expanded is present on the toggle button - good a11y.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: /auth → fill email/password → click 'EINLOGGEN' → redirects to /admin for admin user, then explicit navigation to /dashboard is required. CollapsibleSection uses conditional rendering ({open && ...}) so `-body` testids only exist in DOM when expanded. Verify with query_selector null-checks, not visibility.
